block-destructive-commands.name: Block Destructive Commands
block-destructive-commands.description: Best-effort, on parsed commands (echo ignored); one verdict table shared with rtk-dangerous-actions-blocker. Blocks recursive deletes of root, home, abs paths or .git; mv/chmod/chown -R of system dirs; dd to devices, mkfs; lockouts; force, delete, mirror pushes; history rewrites; switch --discard; IaC destroy; cloud deletes; DB drops. Asks: rm -rf off a safe list, one named kubectl delete, bare lease, stash drop, -auto-approve, drain, prunes, API deletes. Dry runs pass. Pre-push: no non-ff.

block-no-verify.name: Block Skipping Git Hooks
block-no-verify.description: Friction, not a security boundary: refuses agent commands that skip git hooks. --no-verify on commit/push/merge/am/rebase/pull/cherry-pick/revert, -n on commit/am; core.hooksPath set by -c, git config or GIT_CONFIG_*; HUSKY=0, SKIP=, LEFTHOOK=0 and kin; hook manager uninstall; aliases and rebase --exec defined in the command. Asks on plumbing, unset hooksPath, another GIT_DIR and config files. Refuses person-only CHOCK_*/marker changes. Mandatory. Misses: older aliases, scripts, $VARs.

eval.name: Chock Eval
eval.description: Run Chock policy eval suite. args(policy_path) returns(pass_rate, verdict) invoke(test, run_evals, promotion_check) exclude(validate, optimize)

optimize.name: Chock Optimize
optimize.description: Improve Chock policy from usage evidence. args(policy_path, >=3 traces) returns(promoted_edit / rejected_record / no_bar) invoke(misfire, ignore, tuning) exclude(policy_init, one_off_edit)

policy-init.name: Chock Policy Init
policy-init.description: Create conformant Chock policy from request. args(request, target_path, artifact_hint) returns(folder, wiring) invoke(skill, hook, rule, workflow, convention, always_never) exclude(coding, edit_existing)

protect-agent-config.name: Protect Agent Config
protect-agent-config.description: Stops an agent editing its guardrails (MITRE ATLAS AML.T0081). Shell guard refuses writes to AGENTS.md, whole agent folders (.claude/, .cursor/, .codex/, .gemini/, .agents/, .chock/, ...), MCP/hook client configs (.mcp.json, ...), guardrails toggles, plugin install markers, chock.lock, hook files of Cline, Kiro, Augment, Windsurf and Devin (user and machine level), ~/.claude.json, Claude Code plugin roots, project config of Kilo Code, opencode, Factory, Amp, Continue and Goose, .git/{hooks,config}, policy implementations/: redirect, rm/mv/tee/sed -i, cp into, git checkout/restore, a write through a symlink; CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_DIRS, claude --plugin-dir, chock resume (best effort). Any case. An instruction file under docs/ asks a person. Coarse: also eval or sh -c of computed text, shells fed by pipe/variable, interpreter one-liners naming such a path. Reads, `chock sync` pass. Edit/Write: tool gate, same set and verdicts. Misses: user config under ~/.config/, writes a script makes, an existing hard link.

protect-main-branch.name: Protect Main Branch
protect-main-branch.description: Keeps agents off main and master: a git hook reads the current branch at commit time and parses the refs being pushed at push time. The hook refuses a violation only where it is installed. As skill text alone this is advice, and nothing stops one.

validate.name: Chock Validate
validate.description: Lint Chock policy conformance. args(policy_id or all) returns(findings, verdict) invoke(validate, check, promotion_to_review) exclude(eval, optimize)
